claim_scope: One three-task visible-development follow-up against the landed xhigh one-shot and fresh Mike cells. Provisional derivative Sol labels; not human gold.

landed_trigger.user_hypothesis: Grounding can be valuable even when the native work product should not quote sources.
landed_trigger.trace_evidence: None of the three requests asks for citations or quotations. The xhigh Banking arm nevertheless devoted 17595 of 67417 Markdown characters to a machine citation block; the deterministic arm devoted 30021 of 84362. Tax and Indenture mostly ignored the same repeated per-document citation directives, showing inconsistent attention cost rather than a stable deliverable requirement.
landed_trigger.scored_baseline: The xhigh one-shot arm leads fresh Mike 176/225 to 172/225 at 614130 versus 590911 logical tokens.

hypothesis: Keep exact whole-document evidence, two tools, two turns, exact-request recency, xhigh effort, and terminal batch generation. Remove the repeated citation-shape directive from each fetched document and add one general rule: ground in exact source text, but put quotations/citations in the deliverable only when requested or native to the professional genre.
invariants: All exact source text and host receipts remain unchanged.
The original request still appears after complete evidence.
No task route, filename, value, criterion, or hidden benchmark content is used.
Explicit citation or quotation instructions in a future task remain authoritative.
No extra tool, model round, drafting stage, checkpoint, index, or review is added.
decision_rule: Advance if the Sol aggregate exceeds 176/225, or if it preserves at least 176/225 while reducing logical tokens. Reject if grounding quality or criterion coverage falls.
